benefits: It is possible to apply for a grant with a maximum of EUR 30,000
International travel expenses for economy class air travel or train fares
Research expenses, including domestic travel, representation expenses, costs for meetings and other costs necessary to carry out the research
Replacement grant (see the Call for Proposals for more information)
The mission will help fellows to find accommodation and a place to work
eligibility: Open to all PhD graduates at a listed research organisation: universities and universities of applied sciences, university medical centres, KNAW institutes and NWO institutes, the Netherlands Cancer Institute, the Max Planck Institute for Psycholinguistics in Nijmegen, Naturalis Biodiversity Center, ARCNL, the Princess Maxima Center, IHE Delft Institute for Water Education, and TO2 institutions
Open to 'lectoren' and senior researchers of universities of applied sciences
The contract of the applicant should be running at least until the end of the fellowship period
Researchers who did not obtain their PhD degree yet, but whose PhD date is fixed, are also eligible to submit a proposal; they must have obtained their PhD degree at the start of the fellowship
Researchers can apply for a maximum of 1 of the 12 selected positions for 2027
Fellows must be available between 1 March 2027 and 29 February 2028
requirements: Applications must be submitted through the Isaac application and reporting system
If you do not have an Isaac account yet, create one at least one workday in advance
The proposal is written in English
It is mandatory to upload the budget (Excel file, standard format provided) as an annex to the proposal in Isaac

State in the motivation letter which fellowship you are interested in, why you are suitable, why your fellowship will be of value, your availability in the period 1 March 2027 to 29 February 2028, any experience with the subject and possibly with the mission in question, and your approach to involving relevant local partners/stakeholders
You may not mention h-indexes, journal impact factors, or any other indicator or term that refers to the general quality or reputation of a journal, publisher, or publication platform
Proposals submitted after the deadline will not be taken into consideration by NWO
documents: Motivation letter (PDF, max. 2 x A4 in Calibri font size 10, normal margins, single line spacing) including a provisional working plan detailing goals, objectives and action steps
Key outputs (PDF, max. 5 items) with one hyperlink per item and the status of each output clearly indicated
Budget form (Excel file, standard NWO format; the budget form was replaced with a new version on 12 August 2026)
Signed statement by the main applicant in Isaac
selection_criteria: Quality and motivation of the applicant (40% weighting in assessment): scientific quality and experience from the narrative CV, capacity for cooperation and independence, ability to communicate the benefits of research, and motivation to contribute to the ESF-NL objective
Match between the applicant and the assignment as formulated by the mission (40% weighting in assessment), including experience with the topic and with the mission in question
Feasibility (20% weighting in assessment): the applicant can be posted abroad for 1-3 months and the assignment can be carried out within the proposed time frame

Given the expertise present in the assessment committee and the small size of the grant, NWO assesses proposals without involving referees under Article 2.2.4, second subsection of the NWO Grant Rules 2024
coverage: International travel expenses for economy class air travel or train fares
Research expenses, including domestic travel, representation expenses, costs for meetings and other costs necessary to carry out the research

official.application_route: Online through NWO's Isaac application and reporting system via the ESF-NL 2027 apply link on the call page.
official.citizenship_residency: No citizenship or residency requirement is published; eligibility rests on employment at, or a fixed PhD date with, a listed Dutch research organisation or a university of applied sciences.
official.international_eligibility: Not framed as an international-student scholarship: applicants must be employed at a listed Dutch research organisation or be a 'lector' or senior researcher at a Dutch university of applied sciences.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants choose one of 12 mission assignments, each with its own published theme, for example Australia (advancing sustainable aviation: procurement for innovative solutions), Taiwan (critical materials resilience through semiconductor waste streams), Vietnam (sustainable nature-based solutions for delta resilience in the Mekong Delta) and Canada (trusted AI cooperation).
official.research_requirement: A motivation letter including a provisional working plan detailing goals, objectives and action steps, plus a stated approach to involving relevant local partners and stakeholders.
official.duration: 1 to 3 months of secondment to a Dutch diplomatic mission; the stay does not need to be continuous but travel frequency is restricted to a maximum of 2 return trips
official.description: NWO and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs are looking for 12 researchers who would like to bring their scientific expertise and networks to a mission abroad for 1 to 3 months, strengthening the interaction between diplomacy and science so that fellows contribute to evidence-informed Dutch foreign policy.
official.program_type: Government-funded research secondment fellowship placing researchers at Dutch diplomatic missions abroad
official.english_requirement: The proposal is written in English. No IELTS or TOEFL score is published.

number of fellowship positions per mission
verification.notes: Maximum grant of EUR 30,000 per project confirmed on NWO's own call page ('It is possible to apply for a grant with a maximum of EUR 30,000') and in the NWO news item of 23 June 2026 ('The budget per project is EUR 30,000'); the offer terms (travel, accommodation, research expenses, replacement grant) come from the same call page. NWO itself publishes two different total budgets for this call: EUR 390,000 in the body text versus EUR 360,000 in the Characteristics block, so the total was not recorded as a figure.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a costed secondment, not a scholarship: you keep your Dutch employer's contract and NWO reimburses the mission stay's travel, accommodation and research costs, plus a replacement grant so your home institution can cover your duties. The ceiling of EUR 30,000 is shared across all of that, so the fit with your chosen mission matters more than the headline number. The 2027 round closed on 10 September 2026 at 14:00 CEST, so this record is now a planning document for the next annual round. Assessment is done without external referees by a small committee, which makes the quality of your two-page motivation letter decisive.
applicant_utility.best_fit: PhD graduates, 'lectoren' and senior researchers at Dutch universities, KNAW/NWO institutes and universities of applied sciences whose expertise lines up with one of the 12 published mission themes.
application_readiness_checklist: Pick exactly one mission and read its project description in the Call for Proposals annexes first, because the mission match carries 40% of the assessment, equal to your own track record.
Confirm with your employer that your contract runs to at least 29 February 2028 and agree in writing who covers your home duties, since the replacement grant is what pays for that cover.
Block your availability between 1 March 2027 and 29 February 2028 before writing, and state it explicitly in the letter.
Draft the motivation letter to the exact format: two A4 sides, Calibri 10, normal margins, single spacing, with the provisional working plan inside.
Use the budget form version published on 12 August 2026; older templates were withdrawn and cannot be used.
common_rejection_risks: A generic motivation about science diplomacy that never engages the specific mission's theme or the local partners the mission works with.
Leaving availability for the fellowship window vague, which undermines the feasibility criterion worth 20%.
Citing h-indexes, journal impact factors or platform reputation, which NWO explicitly prohibits anywhere in the proposal.
Applying for more than one of the 12 positions, or submitting on the withdrawn budget template.
An unsigned statement or missing annex in Isaac, which stops the application before any committee sees it.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Daily living costs, visa and residence permit fees, insurance, and any salary beyond the replacement grant; the grant is limited to international travel, accommodation, research expenses and replacement costs.
document_audit: Motivation letter must be a PDF of at most 2 x A4 in Calibri size 10 with normal margins and single line spacing; other fonts or two separate files will not meet the format rule.
Narrative CV is capped at 500 words, so choose the few achievements that evidence cooperation and communication skills.
Key outputs: no more than 5 items, one hyperlink each, and the status of each output must be clearly indicated.
Budget must be on the standard NWO Excel form, in its current 12 August 2026 version.
The statement must be signed by the main applicant inside Isaac, not sent separately.
alerts: The 2027 deadline of 10 September 2026, 14:00 CEST has passed and NWO lists the round as closed; no application can be submitted now.
NWO runs this call roughly once a year - the 2027 round opened on 23 June 2026 - so watch nwo.nl/en/calls for the next round in the same period.
No external referees are used, so the committee's reading of your CV and mission match decides the outcome rather than peer review letters.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Open an Isaac account at least one working day before the deadline, complete the ESF-NL 2027 application form, upload the motivation letter, narrative CV and key outputs as PDFs, attach the Excel budget form, sign the statement in Isaac, and submit before 14:00 CEST on the closing date.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a three-month self-directed research residency at the KITLV in Leiden, not a job: you must already have a steady income and you must not be a Dutch tax resident. The support covers a return economy fare, up to EUR 2,000 per month of Leiden accommodation on receipts, and a case-by-case top-up for Leiden's higher living costs. The live 2027 window closes on 14 October 2026 at midnight CET, only days after this record was verified, so the decision point is essentially immediate. Selection is on documents alone, with no interview, which makes the official application form the whole contest.
applicant_utility.best_fit: PhD-holding researchers outside the Netherlands with a defined publication or archival project on Southeast Asia or the Caribbean that can be finished inside three months.
application_readiness_checklist: Download the current 2027 application form from kitlv.nl and check that either 1 March - 1 June 2027 or 1 June - 1 September 2027 fits your calendar.
Confirm your tax residency is outside the Netherlands and line up evidence of the steady income you will live on during the fellowship.
Plan around the receipt rule: accommodation is reimbursed only against proof of payment, so keep leases, invoices and transfer records from day one.
If you need a residence permit, start it early - KITLV supplies an invitation letter and support, but you file the application yourself.
Line up your own Leiden housing lead before the decision, since KITLV will not help find accommodation.
common_rejection_risks: Sending a cover letter or extra documents instead of the official form, which the call says should be uploaded in its place and which can make the application 'incomplete'.
Being a Dutch tax resident, or having no demonstrable steady income for the full three months.
Treating the EUR 2,000 as a stipend: it is only an accommodation reimbursement, so Leiden rent above that level comes out of your own pocket.
Emailing the application to the Program Chair, which the call explicitly prohibits.
A CV running past two pages or written in a language other than English.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Food, anything beyond local transport reimbursement, visa and residence permit fees, insurance, and any Leiden rent above the EUR 2,000 monthly accommodation cap.
document_audit: The application form must be the official 2027 form and is uploaded instead of a cover letter.
The CV must be brief and two pages maximum.
Everything must be in English, including the research proposal inside the form.
Submit only through the Apply Now route; direct email to the Program Chair is explicitly ruled out.
alerts: The 14 October 2026 midnight CET deadline falls just after this record was verified, so the 2027 window is effectively closing now.
Selection runs on documents alone with no interviews, and KITLV will not look at anything before the deadline, so there is no benefit to submitting early.
The programme selects twice a year: if this window is missed, the next call is normally published in September.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the official online form plus a two-page CV in English and submit through the KNAW 'Apply now' button before midnight CET on 14 October 2026; a rotating committee of KITLV staff then assesses the documents without interviews.
